title: Merge two organizations
subtitle: One record absorbs the other. Nothing is deleted: the absorbed record stays available.

forbidden.description: Merging moves affiliations across every edition. It requires a right valid platform-wide.

notFound.title: Merge unavailable
notFound.description: One of the two records does not exist, or has already been absorbed by another. A merged record cannot be merged twice.

picker.title: Pick the second record
picker.description: Search by name, acronym or former name — the same search as the affiliation form.

direction.title: Which absorbs which
direction.absorbingHint: It survives, keeps its address and receives everything below.
direction.suggested: Suggested direction: the verified record, or the higher scoring one, absorbs the other. The decision is yours.

compare.title: Both records, field by field
compare.description: Differences are highlighted. For each diverging field, choose the value to keep.
compare.onlyOn: Filled on one side only: this value will be kept.
compare.unresolved: {count} field left to decide | {count} field left to decide | {count} fields left to decide

transfer.title: What will be transferred
transfer.description: Each module declares its affiliations; the merge walks through them one by one.
transfer.dedupedHint: The record kept already holds these affiliations: duplicating them would fail the merge.
transfer.deletedHint: These are settings belonging to the absorbed record, not activity data.
transfer.none: Nothing to transfer for this record.
transfer.total: {count} item moved in total | {count} item moved in total | {count} items moved in total

names.title: Names brought over
names.description: The record kept will answer to these names: a search on the former name will find the right record.

warnings.title: Check before merging
warnings.source_is_verified: “{name}” carries the IFDD seal and the record kept does not. The seal is not transferred: verify the record kept after the merge.
warnings.source_has_more_activity: The absorbed record holds more submissions than the record kept ({source} against {target}). Check the direction of the merge.
warnings.source_has_verified_domain: The absorbed record holds a verified domain. It will move to the record kept, which inherits automatic affiliation.
warnings.target_not_verified: Neither record is verified. The merge changes nothing there: the record kept will still need verification.
warnings.different_countries: The two records declare different countries. Two bodies of the same network are not the same organization.
warnings.different_types: The two records declare different organization types.

reversible.title: What the merge preserves
reversible.record: The absorbed record stays available, marked “merged”.
reversible.urls: Its former addresses keep working and lead to the record kept.
reversible.trace: The merge is logged with its author, date and reason.

reason.label: Reason for the merge
reason.placeholder: Record created twice by a colleague who could not find the existing one.
reason.hint: Required. It is written to the merge log.

confirm.title: Confirm the merge
confirm.description: “{source}” will be absorbed by “{target}”. To confirm, type the name of the absorbed record.
confirm.label: Name of the absorbed record
confirm.hint: Its acronym works too. Accents and case do not matter.
confirm.mismatch: This name does not match the absorbed record.

result.title: Merge completed
result.rows: {count} item moved | {count} item moved | {count} items moved
result.fields: {count} field filled from the absorbed record | {count} field filled from the absorbed record | {count} fields filled from the absorbed record

error.mismatch: The name you typed does not match the absorbed record. Nothing was merged.
error.generic: The merge did not complete. Nothing was changed.
